content.value: A single gate V belt is to be selected to deliver engine power to the wheel drive transmission of a riding tractor. A 5-hp single-cylinder engine is used. At most, 60 percent of this power is transmitted to the belt. The driving sheave has a diameter of 6.2 inch, the driven sheave has a diameter of 12.0 inch. The belt selected should be as close to a 92 inch pitch length as possible. The engine speed is governor controlled to a maximum of 3100 rev/min. Select a satisfactory belt and assess the factor of safety and the belt life in passes.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
